property_summary: For any call to fallback with 10 ether where block.number % 15 != 0, the resulting pastBlockTime must equal the block.timestamp at the end of the call plus 1; the mutant sets it to plus 2 instead, always violating the invariant on the next non-transfer call.
change_summary: Change pastBlockTime assignment to block.timestamp + 2 instead of + 1.
